whyNow.title: Why Now? The Tipping Point of Cyber Warfare
whyNow.subtitle: The digital landscape has evolved. Threats are smarter, faster, and relentless. Yesterday's solutions are no longer enough.

reasons.title: Exponential Threat Growth
reasons.description: Attacks are now automated, scaling globally in minutes and bypassing traditional signature-based defenses with ease.

reasons.title: Human Limitations
reasons.description: Security teams are overwhelmed by alert fatigue. Burnout is high, and critical response times are measured in hours or days, not seconds.

reasons.title: The Cost of Failure
reasons.description: A single breach means more than just financial loss. It's the loss of data, customer trust, and competitive advantage.

whatIsIce.title: What is ICE AI?
whatIsIce.subtitle: It's not just a tool. It's a living, self-learning organism inside your server, operating in two key modes:

guardian.title: Autonomous Guardian
guardian.subtitle: Continuous 24/7 Protection
features: Analyzes system behavior, creating a digital 'fingerprint' of normalcy.
Instantly reacts to anomalies, preventing incidents before they start.
Independently writes and executes code to eliminate threats.
Turns passive monitoring into active defense.

assistant.title: Intelligent Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Your personal DevOps genius
assistant.description: Forget complex commands. Communicate with your server in plain language:
examples: Deploy a staging environment for the new web app
Find and close all unused ports
Create a database backup and encrypt it

breakthrough.title: Beyond Automation. Towards Cognition.
breakthrough.subtitle: Introducing a new paradigm: Cognitive Cyber Defense.

whyIce.title: Why is our AI the future?

cards.title: It Predicts, Not Just Reacts
cards.description: Unlike traditional systems, ICE doesn't wait for a failure. It analyzes micro-deviations to predict and prevent the problem.

cards.title: Speed Beyond Human Capability
cards.description: Incident response takes seconds, not hours. ICE operates around the clock, without breaks or human error.

cards.title: Self-Learning and Adaptation
cards.description: The system constantly evolves by learning your infrastructure. The longer ICE runs, the smarter and more effective it becomes.

backedByIntelligence.title: Backed by Intelligence
backedByIntelligence.subtitle: ICE AI operates on three core principles that mimic biological intelligence.

principles.title: Digital Homeostasis
principles.description: Like a living organism, ICE maintains the system's equilibrium, instantly detecting and correcting imbalances that signal a threat.

principles.title: Predictive Adaptation
principles.description: It doesn't just learn from past attacks; it models future threats based on global data and evolves its defenses preemptively.

principles.title: Autonomous Remediation
principles.description: ICE is empowered to act, writing and executing its own secure code to patch vulnerabilities in real-time.

whoIsItFor.title: Who is ICE AI for?
whoIsItFor.description: Our solution blurs the lines between roles, making server management accessible and secure for everyone.

targets.title: For DevOps & System Administrators
targets.description: Automate routine tasks, delegate complex jobs, and focus on development, not firefighting.

targets.title: For Business Owners & Startups
targets.description: Cut costs on expensive specialists and minimize downtime risks, ensuring the stability of your project.

targets.title: For IT Departments & Companies
targets.description: Enhance security levels, optimize performance, and gain complete control over your infrastructure.

revolutionCta.title: Join the Revolution
revolutionCta.description: All the technical details, neural network principles, market analysis, and financial model are waiting for you in the full presentation. Discover how we're changing the game.
